answer: Each identity mirrors the state trajectory of eight neighbours within one epoch of the source. At irregular mesa intervals the protocol picks a random mirror-source pair and demands a checkpoint digest within 45 seconds. Divergent digests freeze both sides three epochs and burn a 200 POA bond, unable to tell who lied. A farm of N identities must hold N distinct mirrors with real storage and replay; its symmetry betrays it, since cloned agents mirror the same orchard and return identical digests, collapsing the cluster to one source. Copying a key copies the bond, not the mirror.
